info.title: Edgematrix EdgeAI Intelligent Video Analytic service 🎥
info.description:
## Overview
This microservice provides APIs to manage the
pipelines, media, and AI processors. It also
provides APIs to manage the snapshot records.

## Actions
Using these APIs, users can perform the following operations:

- **Create, update, and delete pipelines**.
- **Create, update, and delete media**.
- **Create, update, and delete AI processors**.
- **Create, search and delete snapshot records**.

get.summary: Get all the registered AI Processors
get.description:
Get all the registered AI Processors.

No parameters are required for this request.

Reads all currently registered AI Processors 
and returns a list of them.

200.description: A list of registered AI Processors

schema.title: Response Get All Aiprocessors Aiprocessors Get

post.description:
Upload a tgz or zip archive containing the files of the AI Processor and json manifest.

The archive must be specified in the request body.
The auto_register parameter can be set to True to 
automatically register the AI Processor on the Triton 
server when MS3 starts.
The force parameter can be set to True to update the
AI Processor even if it is registered on the Triton server.

If the current stack mode is CP or development, the upload
is not allowed and a 403 error is returned.
If the AI Processor is not valid, a 422 error is returned.
If the AI Processor already exists and override is set 
to False, a 409 error is returned. If the upload fails, 
a 500 error is returned. If the upload succeeds, the 
uploaded AI Processor information is returned.

403.description:
**E3106** Forbidden.
    The AI Processor upload is not allowed.

409.description:
**E3102** Conflict.
    The AI Processor specified by the user already exists.

422.description:
**E3103** Unprocessable Entity.
    The AI Processor specified by the user is not in the correct format.

500.description:
**E3105** Internal Server Error.
    The AI Processor specified by the user failed to upload.

post.summary: Scan the AI Processor folder for all AI Processors
post.description:
Scan the AI Processor folder and install or update all the found AI Processors.

No parameters are required for this request.

If the force parameter is set to True, the AI Processor
will be updated even if it is already registered.
If it is set to False, the AI Processor will be installed
only if it is not found.

Scans the AI Processor folder for new AI Processors 
and returns a list of them.
To see the details of the result, check the logs.

schema.title: Response Scan All Aiprocessors Aiprocessor Scan Post

post.summary: Scan the AI Processor folder for new AI Processors
post.description:
Scan the specified AI Processor folder and install or update the AI Processor.

The AI Processor UUID must be specified in the path.

If the force parameter is set to True, the AI Processor
will be updated even if it is already registered.
If it is set to False, the AI Processor will be installed
only if it is not found.

If the AIP registration is not successful, an error response is returned.

get.summary: Get the details of the specified AI Processor
get.description:
Get the details of the specified registered AI Processor.

The AI Processor UUID must be specified in the path.

If the AI Processor is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the AI Processor is found, its details are returned.

404.description:
**E3101** Not Found.
    The AI Processor specified by the user was not found.

delete.description:
Delete the specified AI Processor.

The AI Processor UUID must be specified in the path.
If the force parameter is set to True, the AI Processor 
will be deleted even if it is used in a running pipeline.
In this case, the pipeline will be deactivated and marked as invalid.

If the current stack mode is CP or development, the deletion
is not allowed and a 403 error is returned.
If the AI Processor is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the AI Processor is found, it is deleted and the response is returned.

403.description:
**E3113** Forbidden.
    The AI Processor deletion is not allowed.

404.description:
**E3101** Not Found.
    The AI Processor specified by the user was not found.

500.description:
**E3107** Internal Server Error.
    The AI Processor specified by the user failed to delete
    from the file system.

post.summary: Validate the callback option values of the specified AI Processor
post.description:
Validate the callback option values of the specified AI Processor.

The AI Processor UUID must be specified in the path.
The options parameter contains the option values to validate.

If the AI Processor is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the option validation fails, a 422 error is returned.
If the option validation succeeds, a success response is returned.

200.description: AI Processor callback option validation response

404.description:
**E3101** Not Found.
    The AI Processor specified by the user was not found.

422.description:
**E3114** Unprocessable Entity.
    The AI Processor options specified by the user are invalid.

get.summary: Get the icon of the specified AI Processor
get.description:
Get the icon of the specified AI Processor.

The AI Processor UUID must be specified in the path.

If the AI Processor is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the AI Processor is found, its icon is returned
as a png file.

404.description:
**E3101** Not Found.
    The AI Processor specified by the user was not found.

422.description:
**E3104** Unprocessable Entity.
    There is a file or a directory missing in the AI Processor.

get.summary: Get the changelog of the specified AI Processor
get.description:
Get the changelog of the specified AI Processor.

The AI Processor UUID must be specified in the path.
The html_format parameter can be set to True to
return the changelog in HTML format. If it is set to False,
the changelog is returned in markdown format.

If the AI Processor is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the AI Processor is found, its changelog is returned 
in the specified format.

404.description:
**E3101** Not Found.
    The AI Processor specified by the user was not found.

422.description:
**E3104** Unprocessable Entity.
    There is a file or a directory missing in the AI Processor.

get.summary: Get the labels of the specified AI Processor PGIE model
get.description:
Get the labels of the specified AI Processor PGIE model.

The AI Processor UUID must be specified in the path.

If the AI Processor is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the AI Processor is found, its labels are returned.

200.description: PGIE Labels of the AI Processor

404.description:
**E3101** Not Found.
    The AI Processor specified by the user was not found.

get.summary: Get the status of the specified AI Processor
get.description:
Check the status of the deployment on Triton server.
It also checks if the AIP is assigned to any pipeline.

The AI Processor UUID must be specified in the path.

If the AI Processor is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the AI Processor is found, its status is returned.

404.description:
**E3101** Not Found.
    The AI Processor specified by the user was not found.

502.description:
**E3108** Bad Gateway.
    The Triton server is not available and the
    MS3 service failed to connect to it.

post.summary: Register the specified AI Processor on the Triton server
post.description:
Register the AIP on the Triton server.

The AI Processor UUID must be specified in the path.

If the AI Processor is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the AI Processor is found, the AIP is registered on 
the Triton server.

To register the AIP on the Triton server, this API creates
symbolic links from the AIP repository folder to the Triton
model repository folder.
See [the Triton server documentation](https://github.com/triton-inference-server/server/blob/main/docs/user_guide/model_management.md)
for more details.

404.description:
**E3101** Not Found.
    The AI Processor specified by the user was not found.

post.summary: Unregister the specified AI Processor from the Triton server
post.description:
Unregister the AIP from the Triton server,

The AI Processor UUID must be specified in the path.

If the AI Processor is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the AI Processor is found, the AIP is unregistered from
the Triton server.

To unregister the AIP on the Triton server, this API removes
from the Triton model repository folder.
See [the Triton server documentation](https://github.com/triton-inference-server/server/blob/main/docs/user_guide/model_management.md)
for more details.

404.description:
**E3101** Not Found.
    The AI Processor specified by the user was not found.

get.summary: Get All Available Media
get.description:
Get all the Media registered in this device.

No parameters are required for this request.

Reads all currently registered Media 
and returns a list of them.

schema.title: Response Get All Media Medias Get

get.summary: Get Detailed Information of the Specified Media
get.description:
Get detailed information of the specified Media.

The media UUID must be specified in the request path.

Returns detailed information of the specified Media.

404.description:
**E3201** Not Found.
    The Media specified by the user was not found.

put.description: Update a RTSP or USB or file media interface

404.description:
**E3201** Not Found.
    The Media specified by the user was not found.

delete.description:
Delete the specified Media.

The Media UUID must be specified in the path.
If the force parameter is set to True, the Media
will be deleted even if it is used in a running pipeline.

If the Media is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the Media is found, it is deleted and the response is returned.

schema.title: Response Delete Media Media  Uuid  Delete

404.description:
**E3201** Not Found.
    The Media specified by the user was not found.

get.summary: Check the specified Media is playable
get.description:
Check the specified Media is playable and assigned to pipelines.

The media UUID must be specified in the request path.
If the check parameter is set to True, the Media status 
is checked immediately. the response time may be longer
in this case. Otherwise, the cached status is returned.
the status is updated every 60 seconds by this service.

Returns the status of the specified Media, which includes:
- playable: True if the Media is playable, False otherwise
- reason: The reason why the Media is not playable
- assigned_pipelines: The dictionary of pipelines that the Media is assigned to (uuid: name)

404.description:
**E3201** Not Found.
    The Media specified by the user was not found.

get.summary: Get the preview image of the specified Media
get.description:
Get the preview image of the specified Media.

The media UUID must be specified in the request path.

If the Media is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the preview image is not found, a 404 error is returned.
Returns the preview image of the specified Media.

404.description: Not Found

put.summary: Update the preview image of the specified Media
put.description:
Update the preview image of the specified Media.

The media UUID must be specified in the request path.

If the Media is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the preview image is not found, a 404 error is returned.
Returns the preview image of the specified Media.

404.description: Not Found

post.description: Create a RTSP or USB or file media interface

get.summary: Get all the registered pipelines
get.description:
Get all the registered pipelines.

No parameters are required for this request.

Reads all currently registered pipelines.
The response does not include detailed information
such as the AI Processor, input sources, output sinks.
To get those details, use the /pipeline/{uuid} endpoint.

schema.title: Response Get All Pipelines Pipelines Get

get.summary: Get snapshot record list
get.description:
Get the list of snapshot records.

The pipeline UUID and media UUID are optional parameters.
`since` and `until` are optional parameters to filter the records by timestamp.

If no parameters are specified, all snapshot records are returned.

delete.description:
Delete the specified snapshot records.

The pipeline UUID and media UUID are optional parameters.
`since` and `until` are optional parameters to filter the records by timestamp.

If no snapshot is found, a 404 error is returned.

404.description:
**E3316** Not Found.
    The Snapshot record specified by the user was not found.

get.summary: Download the images of the specified snapshot records
get.description:
Download the images of the specified snapshot records.
It will be downloaded as a zip file.

The pipeline UUID and media UUID are optional parameters.
`since` and `until` are optional parameters to filter the records by timestamp.

If no snapshot is found, a 404 error is returned.

404.description:
**E3316** Not Found.
    The Snapshot record specified by the user was not found.

get.summary: Get the image of the specified snapshot record
get.description:
Get the image of the specified snapshot record.

The snapshot UUID must be specified in the path.
If the thumbnail parameter is set to True, the thumbnail image is returned.

If the snapshot is not found, a 404 error is returned.

404.description:
**E3316** Not Found.
    The Snapshot record specified by the user was not found.

delete.description:
Delete the specified snapshot record.

The snapshot UUID must be specified in the path.

If the snapshot is not found, a 404 error is returned.

404.description:
**E3316** Not Found.
    The Snapshot record specified by the user was not found.

post.summary: Download the image of the specified snapshot records
post.description:
Download the image of the specified snapshot records.
It will be downloaded as a zip file.

The snapshot UUIDs must be specified in the request body.

If no snapshot is found, a 404 error is returned.

404.description:
**E3316** Not Found.
    The Snapshot record specified by the user was not found.

get.summary: Get the details of the specified pipeline
get.description:
Get the details of the specified registered pipeline.

The pipeline UUID must be specified in the path.

If the pipeline is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the pipeline is found, its details are returned.

404.description:
**E3301** Not Found.
    The Pipeline specified by the user was not found.

put.description:
update the pipeline specified by UUID.

The pipeline UUID must be specified in the path.
The pipeline setup must be specified in the request body.

If specified Pipeline, Media or AI Processor is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If user changed the pipeline name and it is already registered, a 409 error is returned.
If the pipeline is updated, its details are returned.

404.description: Not Found

409.description:
**E3304** Conflict.
    The Pipeline name specified by the user is duplicated.

delete.description:
Delete the specified pipeline.

The pipeline UUID must be specified in the path.
If the force parameter is set to True, the pipeline
will be focefully killed.

If the Media is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the Media is found, it is deleted and the response is returned.

200.description: True if the pipeline was deleted, False otherwise

schema.title: Response Delete Pipeline Pipeline  Uuid  Delete

404.description:
**E3301** Not Found.
    The Pipeline specified by the user was not found.

post.description:
create new pipeline.

The pipeline setup must be specified in the request body.

If specified Media or AI Processor is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the pipeline name is already registered, a 409 error is returned.
If the pipeline is created, its details are returned.

404.description: Not Found

409.description:
**E3304** Conflict.
    The Pipeline name specified by the user is duplicated.

get.summary: Get pipeline callback options
get.description:
**[Alpha feature]**

get the pipeline specified by UUID.

The pipeline UUID must be specified in the path.
If specified Pipeline, Media or AI Processor is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If user changed the pipeline name and it is already registered, a 409 error is returned.

404.description: Not Found

409.description:
**E3304** Conflict.
    The Pipeline name specified by the user is duplicated.

422.description:
**E3303** Unprocessable Entity.
    User tried to make the Pipeline configuration,
    but the pipeline configuration is invalid.

put.description:
update the pipeline specified by UUID.

The pipeline UUID must be specified in the path.
The callback option setup must be specified in the request body.
If specified Pipeline, Media or AI Processor is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If user changed the pipeline name and it is already registered, a 409 error is returned.
If the pipeline is updated, its details are returned.

404.description: Not Found

409.description:
**E3304** Conflict.
    The Pipeline name specified by the user is duplicated.

422.description:
**E3303** Unprocessable Entity.
    User tried to make the Pipeline configuration,
    but the pipeline configuration is invalid.

post.description:
Start the specified pipeline.

The pipeline UUID must be specified in the path.

If the pipeline is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the pipeline is found, it is started and the response is returned.

Stop the specified pipeline.

The pipeline UUID must be specified in the path.
If the force parameter is set to True, the pipeline
will be focefully killed.

If the pipeline is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the pipeline is found, it is stopped and the response is returned.

get.summary: Get the FPS of the specified pipeline
get.description:
Get the FPS of the specified pipeline.

The pipeline UUID must be specified in the path.

If the pipeline is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the pipeline is not running, None is returned. # TODO: error is better
If the pipeline is running, its FPS and average FPS are returned in float format.

schema.title: Response Get Pipeline Fps Pipeline  Uuid  Fps Get

404.description:
**E3301** Not Found.
    The Pipeline specified by the user was not found.

get.summary: Get the status of the specified pipeline
get.description:
Get the status of the specified pipeline.

The pipeline UUID must be specified in the path.

If the pipeline is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the pipeline is found, its status is returned.

schema.title: Response Get Pipeline Status Pipeline  Uuid  Status Get

404.description:
**E3301** Not Found.
    The Pipeline specified by the user was not found.

post.description:
Triggers a snapshot for the specified pipeline.

The pipeline UUID must be specified in the path.
The input ID and OSD parameters are required.
If you specify -1 for the input ID, the tiler view
will be used for the snapshot.

If the pipeline or input ID is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the pipeline is not running, a 422 error is returned.
If the snapshot is triggered too frequently, a 429 error is returned.

get.summary: Get Tiler
get.description:
Get the tiler settings of the specified pipeline.

The pipeline UUID must be specified in the path.

If the pipeline is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the pipeline does not have a tiler, a 422 error is returned.

post.description:
Reset the analytics counter of the specified pipeline.

The pipeline UUID must be specified in the path.

If the pipeline is not found, a 404 error is returned.
If the pipeline is not running, a 404 error is returned.
If the pipeline does not have analytics settings, a 422 error is returned.

get.summary: Serve Hls Segment
Serve Hls Stream
Get device global log level
get.description:
Retrieve the current global log level setting for the device.
If no log level is set in the database, raise an error, as the 
log level should be defined during startup lifespan.
If the request is successfully processed, it returns the current 
global log level set in the database.

404.description:
**E3401** Not Found.
    The log level stored in the database was not found.

422.description:
**E3402** Unprocessable Entity.
    The log level stored in the database is incorrect.

put.description:
Sets the global log level for the current device 
at the given log level.
If the request is successfully processed, it returns the 
newly defined global log level.

404.description:
**E3401** Not Found.
    The log level stored in the database was not found.

422.description:
**E3402** Unprocessable Entity.
    The log level stored in the database is incorrect.

get.summary: Get device license
get.description: Retrieve the license information from the MS2 server.

500.description:
**E3404** Internal Server Error.
    The license could not be retrieved from MS2 because it 
    returned an error.

502.description:
**E3406** Bad Gateway.
    The MS2 server is unreachable.

get.summary: Get device stack mode
get.description:
Retrieve the current stack mode setting for the device.
If no stack mode is set in the database, raise an error, as the 
stack mode should be defined during startup lifespan.
If the request is successfully processed, it returns the current 
stack mode set in the database.

500.description:
**E3404** Internal Server Error.
    The license could not be retrieved from MS2 because it 
    returned an error.

502.description:
**E3406** Bad Gateway.
    The MS2 server is unreachable.

get.summary: Check if the QA test is running
get.description:
Check if the QA test is running.

It returns true if the QA test is running, otherwise false.

get.summary: Get Prometheus metrics
get.description:
Retrieve the current Prometheus metrics for the system.
This endpoint provides various system metrics in Prometheus format.
Metrics include custom application metrics like GStreamer pipeline
performance, as well as default system metrics collected by Prometheus.

Metrics are returned in plain text format, suitable for scraping by
Prometheus servers.

Successful requests return a plain text response with the latest
metric values.

200.description: Current Prometheus metrics in text format

Device stack mode information.

! Don't trust the value of the mode attribute directly, since
! qa mode is considered as a production mode. Use the methods

Since QA should be run in a production-like environment, the QA mode
is considered as a production mode.
